children: Aspire-Lakewood Holdings CFO Ernest Scheidemann resigned, and CEO Kraig Higginson was designated principal accounting officer and interim CFO.
Designated principal accounting officer and interim Chief Financial Officer
Oral resignation on Nov. 21, 2026; made official by letter on Nov. 23, 2026
He disagreed with his salary in light of additional responsibilities following the Dura Drive Control Systems acquisition. The company disputes his claim that he was constructively terminated.
To serve as interim CFO until a successor is appointed
Higginson will serve as interim CFO while the company searches for a full-time successor
Scheidemann claims entitlement to compensation under his employment agreement; the company disputes that he was constructively terminated.
